triples.subject: Agrafena Alexandrovna
triples.quote: Mitya’s position with Agrafena Alexandrovna had certainly improved, and that she had said that she loved him.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Mitya was roused at once and declared that he would not allow the “scoundrel” to speak like that in his presence!

triples.subject: Maximov
triples.quote: The old man at once confessed that he had done wrong, that he had borrowed “ten roubles in my poverty,” from Dmitri Fyodorovitch

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Dmitri Fyodorovitch had told him, as soon as he arrived, that he had brought three thousand with him.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: “He was always expecting to get some from his father,” said Grushenka in conclusion.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: she had not loved him, but had won his heart as well as his old father’s “in my nasty spite,”

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: she had not loved him, but had won his heart as well as his old father’s “in my nasty spite,”

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: she had seen that Mitya was very jealous of Fyodor Pavlovitch and every one else; but that had only amused her.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: he had “stolen” it from Katerina Ivanovna, and that she had replied to that that he hadn’t stolen it, and that he must pay the money back next day.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: and he wanted to do it at once, at once, regardless of all obstacles, with all the recklessness of the Karamazovs.
